observations: Photo 0: an automatic gearbox lying on an oily concrete floor in a spare parts yard, with the torque converter visible in the bell housing and a transfer unit (AWD power take off) bolted to the side; dealer watermark 'NEMZ AUTOSPARE PARTS'.
Photo 1: the gearbox casing from above, with hoses, wiring connectors, an oil cooler and brackets still attached; a white paper label and red paint marks on the casing are not legible.
The casing is dusty and oil stained but shows no visible cracks or broken mounting ears.
No brand, model, part number or VIN tag can be read in either photo.
The gearbox is out of any car; nothing shows it running, its fluid, or its mileage.

identity.kind: used automatic CVT gearbox with AWD transfer unit, tokunbo
read_from: photo 0 gearbox with torque converter and transfer unit

claims.evidence: The shape fits a transverse CVT with an AWD transfer unit, but no brand, part number or label is readable in photo 0 or photo 1.
The seller's own words also say 'direct from Belgium'; both cannot be true and no photo shows an origin.
The seller's own words also say 'direct tokunbo Japan'; no photo shows an origin.
A sales phrase with nothing to check in a photo.
The gearbox is shown loose on the floor; no clip of it running or shifting in a car.
Noise can only be heard with the unit fitted and running.
No odometer, donor car or record shown.
Photos are too distant to judge bolt heads and sealant lines; no close shots of the case joints.
